articles.title: Coinbase, which holds 5% of all bitcoin, wants the quantum fix started now
articles.description: Coinbase says bitcoin should start preparing for quantum computers now, with flexible addresses, a backup quantum-proof key and a separate debate over lost coins.

articles.title: Ripple adds Stripe-owned wallets to XRP Ledger as AI payments pass 14 million
articles.description: The integration will let software pay for online services using XRP and RLUSD, while questions remain about how much real economic activity the transactions represent.

articles.title: Solana sets Oct. 21 for Alpenglow upgrade targeting 150-millisecond finality
articles.description: The switch will replace Solana’s existing validator voting system, remove vote transactions from blocks and could sharply change headline transaction counts even if user activity stays flat.

articles.title: Bitcoin climbs toward $84,000 after Fed’s Williams sees no rate hikes in 2027
articles.description: ZEC led a broad bounce among major tokens, and Korean chipmakers snapped a five-day losing streak ahead of Thursday’s U.S. inflation data.

articles.title: Largest Philippines crypto exchange, Coins.ph, said to face central bank regulatory action
articles.description: The exchange, which has over 18 million customers, is said to have handled business transactions involving restricted offshore gaming and gambling companies.

articles.title: Strive raising $500 million to buy additional bitcoin with new preferred share class
articles.description: SATS will offer a fixed 15% dividend yield at par and be junior to the company's existing SATA, which pays a variable rate (currently 13%).

articles.title: BNY, Citadel Securities test tokenized U.S. Treasuries to speed up Wall Street financing
articles.description: The transaction shows how blockchain-based government bonds could help trading firms move collateral faster between settlement and financing.

articles.title: Crypto exchange MNX takes on OKX, Bitget offering pre-IPO futures for AI giants
articles.description: MNX is offering a different way to trade the future valuations of private AI companies, including OpenAI, Anthropic and DeepSeek.

articles.title: UK crypto trader says almost $800,000 lost in knife assault as wrench attacks proliferate
articles.description: A crypto trader in the U.K. claimed masked intruders stole nearly $800,000 in cryptocurrency at knifepoint, furthering concerns of "wrench attacks" spreading in the country.

articles.title: South Korea blocks 27 crypto exchanges, including Bitmart and Kucoin
articles.description: The country’s regulators are stepping up their earlier restrictions on mobile apps to websites, targeting unregistered exchanges before investors report losses.

articles.description: The $911 billion Pittsburgh-based asset manager is teaming up with Prometheum to bring blockchain-based share classes of its funds to traditional brokerage accounts.

articles.description: Investors are positioning ahead of today's bank earnings reports and Wednesday’s U.S. inflation data.

articles.title: Russia’s largest bank Sberbank secures approval to trade crypto
articles.description: Sberbank plans to open crypto trading to all clients Dec. 1 and is already testing BTC, ETH and USDT trades in its app.

articles.description: Ledger announced MediaMarket Saturn stopped selling devices after a customer found a corrupted signer in Germany.

articles.title: UK court ruling boosts government’s chances of keeping $5 billion in seized bitcoin
articles.description: The decision concerns 61,000 BTC seized by the Metropolitan Police in its investigation into Zhimin Qian, who pleaded guilty to defrauding thousands of people in China.

articles.title: Bitcoin whale that sat through the March 2020 crash moves $378 million
articles.description: A bitcoin whale that received coins days before the Covid crash and sat through it has moved millions on-chain.

articles.title: Tokenized SanDisk bets saw more liquidations than XRP as Asia’s chip rout wipes out $800 million
articles.description: About $800 million in leveraged positions were wiped out over 24 hours, 86% of them bullish. Chip-stock contracts on crypto exchanges took a chunk of the damage.

articles.title: Once-largest Ethereum NFT marketplace Blur is shutting down after volumes collapse 99%
articles.description: Blur will close its website on Nov. 12 after monthly trading fell from about $1.43 billion at its 2023 peak to under $7 million, ten days after sister project Blast announced its own shutdown.

articles.title: Bitcoin rebounds above $83,000, decoupling from tumbling Korean stocks
articles.description: Bitcoin climbed back above $83,000 after an early dip, decoupling from a sharp slide in Korean chip stocks and weakness in Nasdaq futures ahead of Thursday’s US CPI report.

articles.title: Palantir's Europe head warns the region is 'missing the boat' on AI just as it did with the internet
articles.description: The Palantir UK chief said the U.S. is racing ahead on enterprise AI while Europe hesitates, and explained why he thinks the company faces intense political attacks.

articles.title: Tom Lee sees $2 trillion wealth transfer fueling crypto demand as Bitmine buys more ether
articles.description: The Bitmine chairman said he expects younger investors to drive demand for digital assets as his ether treasury company inches closer to owning 5% of the total supply.

articles.title: Tokenized catastrophe bonds target the disaster-insurance gap
articles.description: A planned Bermuda issuance would put legal ownership onchain and seek capital for disaster risks that remain costly to insure.
